 Another Week with Gulf of Alaska Action 
 Add to Favorites Add Alert 
 Summary
 The Gulf of Alaska remains active with a notable storm for Southcentral Monday-Tuesday. While it will be "stormy," we're not really going to see super snowpack or snow conditions unless you travel above the 2000' snow level. A cooler, weaker storm follows behind with showers through Thursday and then we move towards a weather window this weekend. Hot, wet and nothing else in SE Alaska.
